Metadata.title: Aura Estética | Medical referral in Türkiye
Metadata.description: General information and contact with independent healthcare providers in Türkiye.

Home.title: Understand your options before you decide.
Home.description: Aura Estética facilitates contact with independent healthcare centres and providers in Türkiye so you can learn more and speak directly with the responsible team.
Home.heroAlt: Patient speaking with a coordinator in a bright clinic
Home.cardTitle: Taking your time is part of your care.
Home.cardDescription: Initial information and contact with the relevant provider.
Home.specialtiesDescription: Explore the published areas and request an initial informational conversation without sharing sensitive medical information.
Home.trustDescription: We collect your general area of interest and facilitate contact with the relevant centre or provider. Aura does not provide healthcare or independently arrange accommodation, transport or treatment.
Home.footerRights: General information. Each service and all healthcare are provided by the contracted provider.

Specialties.title: Specialties to explore with confidence
Specialties.description: Explore areas of interest and request contact with independent centres and professionals. Suitability is always decided by the responsible healthcare team.
Specialties.processDescription: Aura collects only what is needed to respond to your request and facilitate contact. We do not diagnose, recommend treatment or replace the healthcare team.

Lead.title: Start with a clear conversation.
Lead.description: An Aura advisor will contact you about your area of interest and, where appropriate, facilitate contact with an independent centre or provider. This request does not confirm treatment, travel or a booking.
Lead.name: Full name
Lead.messagePlaceholder: Tell us which general area you would like to explore
Lead.messageHelp: Do not share diagnoses, reports, photographs or other sensitive medical information.
Lead.companion: I would travel with a companion
Lead.consent: I agree that Aura Estética may contact me about this request.
Lead.pending: The conversation is informational and does not confirm treatment or contracting.
Lead.error: Please review the fields and try again.
Lead.successDescription: Your request was registered with reference {reference}. We will contact you as soon as possible.
Lead.privacyNote: We use your data to respond to this contact request. Do not send photographs, reports or diagnoses through this form.

Clinics.title: Healthcare centres and professionals
Clinics.description: We publish general information and facilitate contact with independent providers, subject to verification and availability.
Clinics.pendingTitle: We are verifying our partner network.
Clinics.pendingDescription: Before publishing a centre or professional, we will review specialties, authorisations, available services, languages and international patient information.

Process.title: How it works
Process.description: Aura facilitates an initial conversation and contact with independent providers. We do not provide healthcare or sell travel packages.
Process.oneTitle: Tell us your area of interest
Process.oneDescription: Choose the specialty you would like to explore without sending sensitive clinical information.
Process.twoDescription: An advisor explains the contact process and the minimum information needed.
Process.threeDescription: Where appropriate, we facilitate contact with the independent centre or provider. Contracting takes place directly with the service provider.
Process.fourDescription: The healthcare team decides suitability and explains its services, terms and follow-up. Aura does not guarantee outcomes or provide the provider's healthcare.

Footer.rights: General information. Each service and all healthcare are provided by the contracted provider.
